new_products.Title: Gen3 AVoIP Receiver
new_products.Sub Title: 4K 60Hz 4:4:4 HDMI / USB-C / KVM over IP receiver
new_products.Product Description:
Broadcast-grade 4K AV over IP receiver

The Nice Gen3 AVoIP Receiver (Gefen GF-HDK18G-VIP-RX) is the receive-side endpoint of the new Gen3 AVoIP distribution platform launched at ISE 2025. It pulls 4K 60Hz 4:4:4 HDMI video, multichannel audio, RS-232, IR and USB off a standard Gigabit network and re-creates them at the display location with virtually zero latency.

  • 4K 60Hz 4:4:4 with HDR10, HDR10+ and Dolby Vision; HDCP 2.3/2.2/1.4 compliant
  • Uncompressed 7.1 LPCM audio with Dolby Atmos, Dolby TrueHD, DTS:X and DTS-HD Master Audio support
  • Built-in scaler and video-wall controller (up to 16 x 16 configurations)
  • Two-port Gigabit Ethernet switch with PoE in for single-cable installs
  • Independent routing of video, audio, RS-232, IR and USB; AES-256 encryption
  • Scales to 65,000 sender/receiver endpoints on a single network

The Gen3 platform is designed for residential, hospitality, retail and command-and-control jobs where Nice ELAN dealers need broadcast-level performance with simple network deployment.

The Nice Gen3 AVoIP Transmitter (Gefen GF-HDK18G-VIP-TX) is the source-side counterpart to the Gen3 receiver. It encodes 4K 60Hz 4:4:4 HDMI, multichannel audio, USB, RS-232 and IR onto a standard Gigabit network for delivery to any number of receivers in a virtual matrix configuration, with point-to-point or full matrix routing.

  • 4K 60Hz 4:4:4 with HDR10, HDR10+ and Dolby Vision
  • HDMI input plus USB-C alternate mode input for laptops and dock-free workstations

  • AES-256 encryption end-to-end
  • Up to 330 ft (100 m) over a single Cat cable
  • Scales to 65,000 endpoints on one network

Sold by Nice's Gefen brand and aimed at dealers replacing legacy HDBaseT matrix systems with a network-based distribution backbone.

new_products.Title: EL-ITP-8
new_products.Sub Title: 8-inch intelligent touch panel with face recognition and voice control
new_products.Product Description:
Intelligent in-wall touch panel for Nice/ELAN

The EL-ITP-8 is Nice's 8-inch wall-mount touch interface for ELAN control systems. It pairs edge-to-edge glass with an integrated 5 MP IntelliVision camera and a dual-microphone array, so users can personalize the home with face recognition and trigger scenes with voice as well as touch.

  • 8" diagonal LCD capacitive touchscreen, 1920 x 1200, edge-to-edge glass
  • IntelliVision face recognition and voice control for hands-free operation
  • Proximity sensor wakes the panel as a hand approaches
  • 7-button flyout for instant lighting scenes, favorites or event maps
  • Mounts portrait or landscape in a standard 2-gang US junction box
  • 10/100 Ethernet or 802.11 b/g/n Wi-Fi; PoE 802.3at powered
  • Available in white (EL-ITP-8-WH) or black (EL-ITP-8-BK) bezel

Designed for any gSC or g1 Nice system to deliver an interactive, full-featured front-of-wall experience for media, lighting, climate, security and surveillance.

new_products.Title: EL-SC-100
new_products.Sub Title: Compact system controller for small to moderate Nice/ELAN installations
new_products.Product Description:
Entry-class Nice system controller

The EL-SC-100 is Nice's mainstream ELAN system controller for smaller and moderately sized homes. It delivers a single point of control and automation for media, climate, lighting, security, surveillance and the rest of the Nice ecosystem in a compact fanless chassis. Where a universal remote would only cover entertainment, the EL-SC-100 brings true cross-subsystem integration backed by the Nice Home Management UI on touch panels, remotes and mobile apps.

  • Integrated IP, serial and infrared control in a one-box design
  • Fanless, ultra-efficient design with no moving parts for long-life reliability
  • Compact form factor for cabinets, structured wiring or behind-display mounting
  • PoE or Wi-Fi connection options to reduce cabling
  • HDMI on-screen display output for video doorbell chimes and feedback

Often paired with the EL-IO-200 Control Extender to add I/O coverage to additional zones without long cable runs.

new_products.Title: EL-SC-100-ZW
new_products.Sub Title: Nice system controller with integrated Z-Wave
new_products.Product Description:
Z-Wave-enabled compact Nice/ELAN system controller

The EL-SC-100-ZW is the Z-Wave variant of Nice's mainstream EL-SC-100 system controller. It adds an embedded Z-Wave radio so dealers can control Z-Wave lighting, locks, thermostats and sensors directly from the Nice Home Management platform without bolting on a separate gateway. Otherwise it carries the same integrated IP, RS-232 and IR control as the standard EL-SC-100, with a fanless chassis sized for cabinets, structured wiring panels or behind-display mounting.

  • Built-in Z-Wave radio for direct device control
  • Integrated IP, serial and IR control in a single chassis
  • PoE or Wi-Fi connectivity, HDMI OSD output
  • Compact fanless design with no moving parts
  • Also bundled in the EL-SC-200-ZW (with EL-IO-200) for medium installs

Targeted at small and moderately sized projects where Z-Wave is the chosen sub-protocol for lighting and energy.

It supports the same IP, RS-232 and IR integration as the rest of the family and is intended for medium-sized residential installations where Z-Wave is the primary low-level automation protocol.

  • Integrated Z-Wave radio - no separate gateway required
  • IP, serial and IR control built in
  • HDMI OSD output for video doorbell chimes and on-screen feedback
  • Runs the Nice Home Management UI on touch panels, remotes and mobile apps
  • Updates handled via Nice Management Cloud

Aimed at dealers standardizing on a Z-Wave-centric stack inside a Nice/ELAN whole-home system.

  • Both units PoE-ready and compact for cabinet or behind-display mounting

The bundle is positioned as the sweet spot for medium Nice/ELAN deployments that need control across two or more areas without long cable runs back to a central rack.

new_products.Title: EL-IPD-PRE-SSI
new_products.Sub Title: Local audio source preamp for ELAN Dante distribution
new_products.Product Description:
Single-source Dante preamp for ELAN whole-home audio

The EL-IPD-PRE-SSI is Nice's compact, single-source Dante input device for ELAN IP audio distribution. Connect a single source (optical, coaxial or analog stereo) and the unit puts it onto the Dante network so any ELAN matrix (EL-IPD-MTX-8CH or EL-IPD-PRE-MSI with the EL-IPD-NAC-EXT card installed) can route it to any zone in the house.

  • One optical TOSLINK, one coaxial RCA, one analog stereo line input (selectable)
  • PCM stereo 96 kHz 24-bit digital audio
  • PoE (802.3af/at) or 5 V 2 A DC powered
  • Drops in behind a TV or near a turntable to put a remote source on the Dante backbone
  • Compact 7" x 4" footprint, 0.65 lb

Perfect for adding TV audio return paths, dedicated source rooms, or hidden source equipment to a Nice/ELAN IP audio system without long analog cable runs.
